summary: I could not refute any identity or capability fact in the gpt-oss-20b record. I re-read the HF API, config.json, chat_template.jinja, README, the arXiv card 2508.10925v1, the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and GLM-4.7-Flash cards, vLLM v0.33.0 source and the llama.cpp guide. All the following match their sources exactly: ownership (verified openai org), dates (createdAt 2025-08-04, outside the window), license, parameter counts, architecture, context, modalities, always-on reasoning with low/medium/high levels, the Harmony tool-call template, the vLLM parsers and validation, the MXFP4 Marlin ordering on sm_120, the cited issues, and every benchmark value (OpenAI 60.7/53.2/37.4, Tau, Aider, Codeforces; NVIDIA 52.44/41.93/15.17/57.20; Z.ai 34.0/47.7/61.0). I also confirmed that the --reasoning-effort-map keys are valid and that the map is applied on the Harmony path. Corrections: (1) The SWE-bench setting 'n=477, 4 tries' comes from the card's Preparedness section about the o3/o4-mini scaffold, not from the Table 3 eval description, so the setting is conflated. (2) The GLM-4.7-Flash column for gpt-oss-20b reuses OpenAI's self-reported AIME/GPQA/HLE values, so its 61.0 and 47.7 have unknown provenance rather than being independent. (3) llama.cpp b12418 is a prerelease build. Newer builds came out the same day, and the latest stable release is v1.0.0 (2026-11-13). (4) Minor: is_harmony vs use_harmony naming, and KV token counts rounded slightly low. Evidence files are in $SCRATCH/fc20/.
